mapper.sql: id, apply_id, request_id, provider_code, user_id, (SELECT up.partner_user_id FROM user_profile up WHERE up.id = user_id) AS partner_user_id, apply_no
mapper.select: SELECT FROM credit_application WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ca.id, ca.apply_id, ca.request_id, ca.provider_code, ca.user_id, (SELECT up.partner_user_id FROM user_profile up WHERE up.id = ca.user_id) AS partner_user_id, ca.apply_no FROM credit_application ca LEFT JOIN credit_lender_status_query latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT q.id FROM credit_lender_status_query q WHERE q.apply_id = ca.apply_id ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ca.id > #{afterId} AND ca.apply_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ca.apply_no) <> '' AND ( latest.id IS NULL OR latest.external_status IS NULL OR TRIM(latest.external_status) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(latest.external_status)) NOT IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUSED', 'FAIL', 'CANCEL') ) ORDER BY ca.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_application ( apply_id, request_id, provider_code, user_id ) VALUES ( #{applyId}, #{requestId}, #{providerCode}, #{userId} )
